annotations.title: Check a tokenized stock before you buy

description: Check a tokenized stock BEFORE BUYING it, by its contract (or Solana mint) and network: can it be moved today (pause state, a permanent delegate), is a controlling address on the OFAC SDN list, does the pool price track the issuer’s reference, is there DEX liquidity to sell into, is it concentrated in one holder, and is it backed where the issuer reports reserves. Each question has a state (ok, caution, not_established) and the answer an overall status: caution, no_warning_found or not_established. THE SELL ANSWER IS AN ESTIMATE, NOT A QUOTE (since 2026-11-27): resultKind estimate_only, isQuote false, a constant-product estimate over aggregated liquidity with notVerified (pool reserves and sides, ticks, fees, route, the quote token’s peg); quote it as such. `notRead` names pause, control, holders and reserves where they were not read (unknown, never clean). `valuation` keeps grossValueUsd and circulatingValueUsd apart (circulating null unless the supply outside the issuer is established), and multiplier null with multiplierStatus not_read is never 1. Never "safe", never advice. Free.

address.description: The token contract (0x…) or Solana mint.

chain.description: The network, where one address is a token on several (ethereum, arbitrum, base, bnb, robinhood, solana, …).

sizeUsd.description: The position the sell question is asked for, in dollars; $10,000 where none is sent.

name: stock_buy_check

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

items.description: question, state, says; on the sell question resultKind (estimate_only | not_established), isQuote false, method and notVerified.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

notRead.description: Since 2026-11-27: pause, control, holders, reserves where not read.

questionsAnsweredByEstimateOnly.description: Answered questions resting on an estimate, not a reading.

valuation.description: Since 2026-11-27: supplyStatus, grossUnits, grossValueUsd, circulatingUnits, circulatingValueUsd (null unless established), grossValuationComplete, circulatingValuationComplete, valuationComplete (v1, gross where gross_only) with valuationCompleteMeans, multiplier and multiplierStatus (read | not_read).

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
